title: Crèche First Term
overview: First Term Curriculum Intent During First Term, the AMES Crèche child should increasingly develop SECURITY -> RELATIONSHIP -> COMMUNICATION -> MOVEMENT -> EXPLORATION -> ROUTINE -> INDEPENDENCE. The three prime EYFS areas receive particular priority while meaningful experiences are provided across Literacy, Mathematics, Understanding the World and Expressive Arts and Design. Teaching rule: Crèche assessment is observational. There is no formal examination week. Teachers observe children through play, conversation, movement, books, songs, mealtimes, self-care, Practical Life, outdoor exploration and relationships. First-Term Curriculum Map Week Big Idea Main Development 1 I Belong Here Security, settling and relationships 2 This Is Me Identity, name and self-awareness 3 My Amazing Body Body awareness and movement 4 I Can Take Care of Myself Hygiene and emerging independence 5 My Family Familiar people and belonging 6 Consolidation / Calendar Flexibility Responsive review / mid-term 7 My Home and My School Familiar environments and routines 8 I Explore With My Senses Sensory discrimination and language 9 Plants Around Me Nature, growth and care 10 Animals Around Me Animals, sounds and movement 11 Shape, Colour, Pattern and Making Early mathematics and creativity 12 Giving, Gratitude and Christmas Christian character and celebration 13 I Have Grown Reflection, transition and term closure Daily Non-Negotiable Curriculum The weekly focus never replaces the everyday Crèche curriculum. Every day should include appropriate opportunities for warm relationships, conversation, free movement, outdoor experience, books, songs and rhymes, purposeful play, sensory exploration, Practical Life, self-care, rest, meals, choice, child-initiated exploration and adult-guided interaction. Crèche Literacy Entitlement There is no formal SSP programme in Crèche. First Term literacy provides daily stories, songs, nursery rhymes, sound play, conversation, picture books, page turning, environmental sounds, meaningful name recognition, drawing, scribbling, large-scale mark-making, finger play and physical preparation. Crèche Mathematics Entitlement Mathematics is experienced through matching, sorting, filling, emptying, stacking, posting, one/more, big/small, full/empty, in/out, up/down, simple quantity, shape, space, movement, pattern, songs and everyday routines. First-Term Practical Life Progression ADULT DOES WITH CHILD -> CHILD HELPS ADULT -> CHILD ATTEMPTS WITH SUPPORT -> CHILD DOES FAMILIAR PARTS INDEPENDENTLY. Priority experiences include carrying, placing, pouring, feeding, wiping, washing hands, putting away, opening/closing, simple dressing participation, plant care and resource restoration. First-Term Language Strategy Adults expand children's language naturally. If a child says 'Dog', the adult may respond, 'Yes, a brown dog. The dog is running.' If a child says 'Water', the adult may respond, 'You want more water.' Adults model richer language without pressuring children to repeat. Inclusion Children may communicate nonverbally, use home language, require sensory or physical adaptations, take longer to settle or show advanced skills. Teachers adapt access without removing curriculum entitlement. Parent Partnership Home connections should remain simple and developmentally appropriate: talk together, name everyday objects, read picture books, sing, count naturally, encourage self-feeding and dressing, sort safe household items, water a plant, notice animals, draw and participate in simple household routines. End-of-Term Curriculum Expectation Depending on age, starting point and individual development, teachers hope to see increasing evidence that the child feels secure with familiar school adults; recognises routines; responds to familiar language; communicates needs increasingly; enjoys books, songs and rhymes; explores confidently; moves with increasing control; uses hands purposefully; participates in self-care; notices body parts and familiar relationships; explores through the senses; notices plants and animals; experiences early mathematical relationships; creates and makes; begins to restore familiar resources; participates alongside other children; and develops greater independence. These are curriculum expectations, not pass/fail examination criteria. Crèche First-Term Declaration We will help children feel safe. We will know them. We will speak with them. We will listen. We will sing. We will read. We will move. We will explore. We will play. We will go outdoors. We will help children care for themselves and their environment. We will protect childhood from premature formalisation. We will observe without turning children into data. We will work with families. We will respect individual development. We will create increasing independence. EYFS-ALIGNED IN FOUNDATION MONTESSORI-INFORMED IN PRACTICE NIGERIAN IN CONTEXT CHRISTIAN IN CHARACTER

weeks.title: I Belong Here
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children begin to experience school as a safe, predictable and caring place.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 1 - I Belong Here

items.title: Security, settling and relationships
items.learningIntent: Children begin to experience school as a safe, predictable and caring place.
items.learningContent:
Children begin to experience school as a safe, predictable and caring place. Adults use children's names and simple routine
language; support separation sensitively; establish arrival, meal, rest and collection routines; provide free movement, carrying,
pushing, stacking and ball play; share picture books and repetitive rhymes; introduce one/more, big/small, in/out and up/down
through real experience; explore the classroom and outdoors; provide welcome songs, mark-making and simple Practical Life.
Character: Love and Belonging. Vocabulary: hello, bye, teacher, friend, school, book, cup, bag, sit, come, more, finished.
Observe: comfort seeking, response to voice, exploration, communication of needs, movement and recognition of routines.

weeks.title: This Is Me
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children increasingly recognise themselves as individuals with a name, face, belongings and preferences.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 2 - This Is Me

items.title: Identity, name and self-awareness
items.learningIntent: Children increasingly recognise themselves as individuals with a name, face, belongings and preferences.
items.learningContent:
Children increasingly recognise themselves as individuals with a name, face, belongings and preferences. Use names frequently,
mirrors, photographs and personal belongings; encourage simple choices; use name songs and personalised picture books; match
familiar objects and explore one/two meaningfully. Practical Life: locate bag/cup and place belongings with support. Character: I
am valued and others are valued. Vocabulary: me, my, name, face, hair, eyes, smile, boy, girl, happy.
items.teachingGuidance:
Use names frequently,
mirrors, photographs and personal belongings; encourage simple choices; use name songs and personalised picture books; match
familiar objects and explore one/two meaningfully.
items.practicalLife: locate bag/cup and place belongings with support

weeks.title: My Amazing Body
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children notice major body parts and discover what their bodies can do.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 3 - My Amazing Body

items.title: Body awareness and movement
items.learningIntent: Children notice major body parts and discover what their bodies can do.
items.learningContent:
Children notice major body parts and discover what their bodies can do. Teach head, hand, foot, eye, ear, nose, mouth and tummy
through action songs, movement, books and play. Explore walking, running where appropriate, reaching, stretching, clapping,
stamping, bending, dancing and ball rolling. Introduce simple functions such as eyes-see, ears-hear, hands-hold. Practical Life:
dressing participation. Character: Gratitude.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 3 - My Amazing Body

weeks.title: I Can Take Care of Myself
weeks.bigIdea: I Can Take Care of Myself
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children participate increasingly in simple self-care.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 4 - I Can Take Care of Myself

items.title: Hygiene and emerging independence
items.learningIntent: Children participate increasingly in simple self-care.
items.learningContent:
Children participate increasingly in simple self-care. Use vocabulary wash, soap, water, clean, dirty, towel, wipe, eat and drink.
Practise handwashing, cup/spoon use, wiping hands and assisted dressing. Explore full/empty and more/less through water play.
Central progression: WATCH -> HELP -> TRY -> REPEAT. Toileting and intimate care remain private, dignified and professionally
managed. Character: Responsibility.
items.teachingGuidance: Use vocabulary wash, soap, water, clean, dirty, towel, wipe, eat and drink.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 4 - I Can Take Care of Myself

weeks.title: My Family
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children strengthen security and language by connecting school learning with familiar relationships.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 5 - My Family

items.title: Familiar people and belonging
items.learningIntent: Children strengthen security and language by connecting school learning with familiar relationships.
items.learningContent:
Children strengthen security and language by connecting school learning with familiar relationships. Use family photographs and
vocabulary mummy, daddy, parent, brother, sister, baby, grandma, grandpa, family and home, while respecting varied family
structures. Share family books and songs; use dolls and home role play; explore small-group quantities informally. Practical Life:
care for dolls. Character: Love and Care.
items.teachingGuidance:

weeks.curriculumIntent: This is not an examination week.
weeks.notes: Responsive review rather than formal examination.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 6 - Consolidation / Mid-Term Flexibility

items.title: Responsive review / mid-term
items.learningIntent: This is not an examination week.
items.learningContent:
This is not an examination week. Revisit settling, language, body awareness, self-care, relationships, movement, books, songs and
independence. Teachers review what each child trusts, communicates and attempts independently, what remains difficult and what
should happen next.

weeks.title: My Home and My School
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children recognise features and routines of familiar places.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 7 - My Home and My School

items.title: Familiar environments and routines
items.learningIntent: Children recognise features and routines of familiar places.
items.learningContent:
Children recognise features and routines of familiar places. Teach home, school, room, door, chair, table, bed, outside, inside and
toilet. Explore inside/outside, on/under, in/out and near/far through movement. Use role play and block building. Practical Life:
carry, place, sort and restore. Use photographs of real local homes, the school and familiar Owo surroundings.
items.teachingGuidance: Use role play and block building.

Teach home, school, room, door, chair, table, bed, outside, inside and
toilet.

weeks.title: I Explore With My Senses
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children investigate through seeing, hearing, touching, smelling and safe tasting.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 8 - I Explore With My Senses

items.title: Sensory discrimination and language
items.learningIntent: Children investigate through seeing, hearing, touching, smelling and safe tasting.
items.learningContent:
Children investigate through seeing, hearing, touching, smelling and safe tasting. Teach see, hear, touch, smell, taste, soft, rough,
loud, quiet, sweet, cold and warm. Provide texture exploration, sound response, sensory materials, sorting, sound makers, collage,
colour and music. Montessori-informed experiences include matching textures, sound discrimination, object sorting and simple
colour matching.
items.montessoriPractice:
Montessori-informed experiences include matching textures, sound discrimination, object sorting and simple
colour matching.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 8 - I Explore With My Senses

weeks.title: Plants Around Me
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children encounter plants as living parts of their environment.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 9 - Plants Around Me

items.title: Nature, growth and care
items.learningIntent: Children encounter plants as living parts of their environment.
items.learningContent:
Children encounter plants as living parts of their environment. Teach plant, leaf, flower, tree, grass, soil, water and grow. Explore
school grounds, touch leaves, observe flowers, water plants and notice size, colour and texture. Use nature books, leaf printing and
collage. Practical Life: plant care. Character: Stewardship.
items.teachingGuidance:
Use nature books, leaf printing and
collage.

school grounds, touch leaves, observe flowers, water plants and notice size, colour and texture.
items.assessmentFocus:

school grounds, touch leaves, observe flowers, water plants and notice size, colour and texture.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 9 - Plants Around Me

weeks.title: Animals Around Me
weeks.curriculumIntent: Children notice familiar animals, sounds, movements and features.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 10 - Animals Around Me

items.title: Animals, sounds and movement
items.learningIntent: Children notice familiar animals, sounds, movements and features.
items.learningContent:
Children notice familiar animals, sounds, movements and features. Prioritise recognisable local animals such as dog, cat, goat,
chicken, bird, fish and cow. Use movement imitation, matching, picture books and rhymes. Introduce basic observations about
sound, movement, body covering and where animals live. Character: Gentleness and care.
items.teachingGuidance: Use movement imitation, matching, picture books and rhymes.
items.nigerianAfricanContext:

chicken, bird, fish and cow.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 10 - Animals Around Me

weeks.title: Shape, Colour, Pattern and Making
weeks.curriculumIntent: big/small, round, same/different and repeated experiences.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 11 - Shape, Colour, Pattern and Making

items.title: Early mathematics and creativity
items.learningIntent: big/small, round, same/different and repeated experiences.
items.learningContent:
Children explore early mathematical relationships through real objects, movement and construction: match, sort, fit, stack,
big/small, round, same/different and repeated experiences. Use blocks, posting, puzzles, large mark-making, paint, printing,
tearing, sticking, music and movement. Montessori-informed work includes simple matching, sorting, obvious size grading, posting
and stacking. Adults protect purposeful repetition and concentration.
items.teachingGuidance:
Use blocks, posting, puzzles, large mark-making, paint, printing,
tearing, sticking, music and movement.
items.montessoriPractice:
Montessori-informed work includes simple matching, sorting, obvious size grading, posting
and stacking.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 11 - Shape, Colour, Pattern and Making

weeks.title: Giving, Gratitude and Christmas
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 12 - Giving, Gratitude and Christmas

items.title: Christian character and celebration
items.learningContent:
Children experience Christmas within the school's Christian identity through story, music, relationships, gratitude and giving rather
than academic worksheets. Teach Christmas, Jesus, baby, gift, give, thank you, love, joy and family. Share an age-appropriate
Nativity story, songs, movement and child-led festive art. Character: Love, Joy, Gratitude and Giving.
items.parentHomeConnection: Teach Christmas, Jesus, baby, gift, give, thank you, love, joy and family.
items.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 12 - Giving, Gratitude and Christmas

weeks.title: I Have Grown
weeks.curriculumIntent: Celebrate development without an academic performance contest.
weeks.sourceSection: Crèche First Term / Week 13 - I Have Grown

items.title: Reflection, transition and term closure
items.learningIntent: Celebrate development without an academic performance contest.
items.learningContent:
Celebrate development without an academic performance contest. Revisit school, self, body, family, care, senses, plants, animals,
colour, shape, songs, stories and routines. Review the child across the seven EYFS areas plus Practical Life/independence using
professional observation, conversation, selected creations, purposeful authorised photographs, parent information and significant
learning records.

professional observation, conversation, selected creations, purposeful authorised photographs, parent information and significant
learning records.
